option_relations.rationale: Decompensated biventricular heart failure with reduced ejection fraction is a specific type of acute decompensated heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy with pre-excitation is a distinct cardiac condition not directly related to the provided leaf of acute decompensated heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.

Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) pattern with heart failure exacerbation describes a specific arrhythmia pattern co-occurring with heart failure, but the option itself is not a direct subtype or supertype of the provided leaf, nor is it an etiology or manifestation of the leaf.
Decompensated heart failure is a broader category that includes acute decompensated heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
